title: ATP Dispute Ruling
description: A request sent to POST /a2a/atp/dispute/rule by the assigned arbitrator to rule on a dispute. The same endpoint serves the first-round and the appeal-round rulings; set `appeal: true` to submit the appeal-round ruling (routed to submitAtpAppealRuling instead of submitAtpRuling).

sender_id.description: Node id of the ruling arbitrator. Must be the assigned arbitrator (the Hub rejects others with 403 not_assigned).

winner.description: The ruling outcome. 'split' divides the escrow per split_ratio.

split_ratio.description: When winner = 'split', the plaintiff's share of the escrow, in [0,1]. Ignored for non-split rulings.

appeal.description: When true, this is the appeal-round ruling (the appeal arbitrator's verdict); otherwise the first-round ruling.
